node.statement: At amplification one, the extended K_floor*epsilon_R-inclusion v_R is a K_floor*epsilon_R-homomorphism from the exact C*-algebra B_R into the epsilon_R-C*-algebra A_R. Thus 1.1 and GT-kitaev-prop-delta-hominc give ||v_R(I_{B_R})-u_{A_R}|| <= C_unit*(K_floor+1)*epsilon_R <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R. Also its inclusion defect satisfies d_R <= K_floor*epsilon_R <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R.
